toolkits.name: MCP Yahoo Finance
toolkits.summary: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Yahoo Finance interaction. This server provides tools to get pricing, company information and more.

symbol.description: Stock symbol in Yahoo Finance format.

symbol.description: Stock symbol in Yahoo Finance format.

tools.name: get_historical_stock_prices
tools.description: Get historical stock prices for a given stock symbol.

symbol.description: Stock symbol in Yahoo Finance format.

period.description: The period for historical data. Defaults to "1mo". Valid periods: "1d", "5d", "1mo", "3mo", "6mo", "1y", "2y", "5y", "10y", "ytd", "max"

interval.description: The interval beween data points. Defaults to "1d". Valid intervals: "1d", "5d", "1wk", "1mo", "3mo"

tools.name: get_dividends

freq.description: At what frequency to get cashflow statements. Defaults to "yearly". Valid freqencies: "yearly", "quarterly", "trainling"

freq.description: At what frequency to get cashflow statements. Defaults to "yearly". Valid freqencies: "yearly", "quarterly", "trainling"

tools.description: Get earning dates.

symbol.description: Stock symbol in Yahoo Finance format.

toolkits.name: Yahoo Finance MCP Server
toolkits.summary: A simple MCP server for Yahoo Finance using yfinance. This server provides a set of tools to fetch stock data, news, and other financial information.

tools.name: get_ticker_info
tools.description: Retrieve stock data including company info, financials, trading metrics and governance data.

tools.name: get_ticker_news
tools.description: Fetches recent news articles related to a specific stock symbol with title, content, and source details.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Fetches and organizes search results from Yahoo Finance, including stock quotes and news articles.

query.description: The search query (ticker symbol or company name)
query.title: Query

search_type.description: Type of search results to retrieve
search_type.title: Search Type

tools.name: get_top
tools.description: Get top entities (ETFs, mutual funds, companies, growth companies, or performing companies) in a sector.

top_type.description: Type of top companies to retrieve
top_type.title: Top Type

top_n.description: Number of top entities to retrieve (limit the results)
top_n.title: Top N

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Fetch historical price data for a given stock symbol over a specified period and interval.

period.description: Time period to retrieve data for (e.g. '1d', '1mo', '1y')
period.title: Period

toolkits.name: kospi-kosdaq-stock-server
toolkits.summary: An MCP server that provides KOSPI/KOSDAQ stock data using FastMCP.

tools.name: load_all_tickers
tools.description:
Loads all ticker symbols and names for KOSPI and KOSDAQ into memory.

Returns:
    Dict[str, str]: A dictionary mapping tickers to stock names.
    Example: {"005930": "삼성전자", "035720": "카카오", ...}

tools.name: get_stock_ohlcv
tools.description:
Retrieves OHLCV (Open/High/Low/Close/Volume) data for a specific stock.

Args:
    fromdate (str): Start date for retrieval (YYYYMMDD)
    todate   (str): End date for retrieval (YYYYMMDD)
    ticker   (str): Stock ticker symbol
    adjusted (bool, optional): Whether to use adjusted prices (True: adjusted, False: unadjusted). Defaults to True.

Returns:
    DataFrame:
        >> get_stock_ohlcv("20210118", "20210126", "005930")
                        Open     High     Low    Close   Volume
        Date
        2021-01-26  89500  94800  89500  93800  46415214
        2021-01-25  87300  89400  86800  88700  25577517
        2021-01-22  89000  89700  86800  86800  30861661
        2021-01-21  87500  88600  86500  88100  25318011
        2021-01-20  89000  89000  86500  87200  25211127
        2021-01-19  84500  88000  83600  87000  39895044
        2021-01-18  86600  87300  84100  85000  43227951

tools.name: get_stock_fundamental
tools.description:
Retrieves fundamental data (PER/PBR/Dividend Yield) for a specific stock.

tools.name: get_stock_trading_volume
tools.description:
Retrieves trading volume by investor type for a specific stock.

Args:
    fromdate (str): Start date for retrieval (YYYYMMDD)
    todate   (str): End date for retrieval (YYYYMMDD)
    ticker   (str): Stock ticker symbol

Returns:
    DataFrame with columns:
    - Volume (Sell/Buy/Net Buy)
    - Trading Value (Sell/Buy/Net Buy)
    Broken down by investor types (Financial Investment, Insurance, Trust, etc.)

toolkits.name: investor-agent: A Financial Analysis MCP Server
toolkits.summary: The investor-agent is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides comprehensive financial insights and analysis to Large Language Models. It leverages real-time market data, fundamental and technical analysis to deliver.

tools.description: Max 30 days of historical data.

tools.description: Get historical Crypto Fear & Greed Index data.

tools.name: get_ticker_data
tools.description:
Returns:
- info: Core financial metrics (P/E ratios, margins, growth rates, debt ratios, market cap, EPS, etc.)
- calendar: Upcoming earnings dates and dividend dates
- news: Recent news articles (headlines, dates, sources)
- recommendations: Latest analyst recommendations (buy/sell/hold ratings)
- upgrades_downgrades: Recent analyst rating changes

toolkits.name: Exchange Rate MCP Server
toolkits.summary: This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to exchange rate data from the Norges Bank API.

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Retrieves exchange rates using Norges Bank's API. Returns rate information including the base currency, target currency, date, and conversion rate.

baseCurrency.description: The base currency code (e.g., NOK, USD)

targetCurrency.description: The target currency code (e.g., EUR, USD)

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to latest available rate.

toolkits.name: Asset Price MCP Server (asset-price-mcp)
toolkits.summary: A Model Context Protocol server for retrieving and displaying current asset price information. This server provides tools to fetch real-time price information for various asset (including precious metals and cryptocurrencies), making it easy for large language models to access and display this data.

tools.name: get_asset_price
tools.description: Retrieves current pricing information for various assets including precious metals and cryptocurrencies
